name: Email phishing check (email JSON with sender, subject, body, links)
description: Format: emails as JSON with from / subject / body / links fields. Questions: yes/no with a probability, a 5-option choice, and a 3-level score.

is_phishing.instructions: Is this email a phishing or scam attempt?

tactic.instructions: What pressure tactic or lure does the email use, if any?

criteria.urgency_threat: account will be closed or suspended, act now
criteria.fake_invoice: unexpected invoice, payment or refund to process
criteria.credential_request: asks you to log in, verify or confirm your password
criteria.prize_or_gift: you won something, free gift card, lottery
criteria.none: a normal legitimate email with no lure

risk.instructions: How risky is it to click the links or follow the instructions?

asks_for_money.instructions: Does the email ask the reader to pay, transfer money, or buy gift cards?

state.subject: Your account will be suspended in 24 hours
state.body: We detected unusual activity. Verify your identity now or your account will be permanently closed.
